question: Task 2 side effect: does raising the OpenAI ceiling from 3000 to 16000 slow down or inflate the small cases?
how: Same method as Phase 0: real UI, fresh diagram per run, verbatim Case C / Case D prompts from docs/baseline-geracao.md 1.1, 3 runs each. rawResponseBytes is the length of the string the app itself logs as '[ir] raw model response:'. clickToLastIrLogMs is Phase 0's own definition - send click to the last IR pipeline log line. apiDurationMs is the PerformanceObserver resource entry for the api.openai.com request.

baselinePhase0.note: docs/baseline-geracao.md 1.2, ceiling 3000. Phase 0's ms column is clickToLastIrLog.

caveat: C-run1's clickToLastIrLogMs of 9835 is inflated: the arm call was a separate tool round trip (~4s) before the send click, so armedAt precedes the click. Runs C2, C3, D1, D2, D3 armed inside the same batch as the click and are clean. apiDurationMs is unaffected in all six.
conclusion: No slowdown and no inflation. C: 4452-5852ms vs a 5400-8534ms baseline; D: 4141-5154ms vs 4774-6237ms. Bytes 2080-2670 (C) and 1963-2145 (D) vs 2577-2921 and 1894-2507. max_tokens is a cap, not a target: the model emits what the diagram needs and stops, so a higher cap costs nothing when the response is small. 6/6 rendered, 0 dropped edges.
